title: Google releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash model
excerpt: The updated model supports 15-second video generation and multi-turn conversational editing at a 30% lower price point.
bodyHtml:
Google announced the release of Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash on November 5, 2026. The model is now generally available across the Gemini API, Google Vids, and Gemini for business platforms.

Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash introduces native video creation for clips up to 15 seconds, an increase from the 10-second limit in the previous version. The update also features multi-turn conversational editing, which allows users to refine clips through follow-up prompts without restarting the generation process, and improved reference adherence for maintaining consistency in characters and objects.

Google stated that the price for the model has been reduced by 30% compared to Gemini Omni 1.1. The service is now available at $0.07 per second for 720p video production.
topic: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
